Answer: C
Reason: The sequential chest X-rays demonstrate rapidly progressive, diffuse bilateral alveolar opacities (Figure 1 and 3) that resolve significantly by day 4 (Figure 4a), a pattern characteristic of Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS) responding to mechanical ventilation and supportive care. Pneumonia typically resolves more slowly, and cardiogenic edema usually presents with cardiomegaly which is not prominent here.
